Thank you all for the concrete findings. Let me summarize what I'm hearing and what needs to go on the formal readiness record before I can finalize:

- The customer update interval would be corrected to 30 minutes, with Support owning those updates.

Rina, is Omar's authorization the only constraint, or are there other infra concerns? Luis, are there any other support agreement requirements beyond the 30-minute interval and Support ownership?

I want to make sure the record is complete before I publish.
